attchmntText: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of financial results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Indo Borax and Chemicals Limited reported unaudited standalone net profit of 1,146.78 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 1,609.06 lakhs in the same period last year. Consolidated net profit for the quarter was 474.57 lakhs versus 1,626.15 lakhs previously. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, standalone net profit stood at 2,772.25 lakhs against 2,612.59 lakhs. Consolidated net profit for the six-month period was 2,099.97 lakhs compared to 2,646.56 lakhs. Basic earnings per share for the quarter was 3.57 rupees. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on 06th November 2026. TJSB Sahakari Bank Limited issued demand notices under Section 13(2) of the SARFAESI Act against borrowers including M/s. Innotech Engineering, Mr. Sanjay Atmaram Patil, and Mr. Shaikh Naveedahmed Nazirahmed for outstanding amounts of 1,58,17,148 rupees, 5,18,214 rupees, and 19,36,118 rupees respectively.

attchmntText: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
